title: Scientific Ontology (SO) / 存在境界論: Public Edition v5.1.1-rc003
description: Scientific Ontology (SO) / 存在境界論 Public Edition v5.1.1-rc003 is a release candidate that retains the v5.1.0 question of what to bring back, revise, and leave unresolved after boundary contact. Its v5.1.1 subtheme is to approach correctness from both sides: deduction from metaphysics and engineering under concrete finite conditions. It separates authorial stance from concept ownership; distinguishes proposition-level adjudication from document/system-level audit; re-examines AMP/ITS/Gödel-derived formation material as formation provenance rather than higher authority; reorganizes generative metaphysics, historical computation, physics-adjacent hypotheses, and Engineering Research on Correctness under a Metaphysical Approach research surface; expands English commensuration; and introduces an experimental deterministic repository machine-audit lane whose findings have no automatic canonical effect.
notes: This is a release candidate, not a published Public Edition. The current published version remains v5.1.0. Formation sources are not promoted into evidentiary or canonical authority, machine-audit findings are not verdicts, and successful tooling does not establish the truth of Scientific Ontology. The deterministic machine-audit lane is a lower-layer precursor to broader Repository-wide alpha/beta audit execution; no Repository-wide alpha/beta audit has yet been executed. Candidate document-index/public-catalog regeneration is restored. The rc003 preview read model validates at 183 public documents and 62 Japanese-English pair families; these are candidate-state validation values, not a retroactive replacement of the published v5.1.0 catalog facts. Full physics/cosmology scientific audit, private-core publication, and DSSI/ConnectBits product-code bundling remain outside this candidate.
